nodes.label: Fake LLM fixture (scriptable, no keys)
nodes.rationale: Autouse pytest fixture replaces generate_response at all three binding sites with a scriptable async fake — production ReAct loop runs unchanged, no API keys required in CI.

nodes.label: Deploy Gate (pytest fast suite)
nodes.rationale: 'python -m pytest' from repo root excludes stress + integration; this is what CI enforces as the merge gate with --cov-fail-under.

edges.source_location: Gate runs without keys/network because the fake LLM autouse fixture replaces generate_response
'pip install -r backend/requirements-test.txt' is a prerequisite of the gate
